strategy.title: Preparation strategy
strategy.description: The proposed operating model for growing interdisciplinary technology teams at ADNSU.

office.name: Startup and Technology Transfer Office
office.text: Coordinates faculty coordinators, mentors, labs and industry partners. Oversees the portfolio, risks, resource allocation and stage reviews.

faculties.name: Faculty coordinators
faculties.text: Identify student and mentor candidates, build interdisciplinary teams and track weekly progress.

mentors.name: Teachers and mentors
mentors.text: Agree the technical direction, team plan and prototype test criteria with the team captain.

labs.name: Laboratories
labs.text: Plan equipment, technical training, test time and resource requests.

teams.name: Students and team captains
teams.text: Define team roles, build the prototype, document results and report weekly.

partners.name: Industry partners
partners.text: Offer problem statements, expertise, components, a real test environment and funding opportunities.

mobilisation.name: Mobilisation
mobilisation.text: Appoint coordinators in the faculties. Register mentor and lab capacity.

selection.name: Selection and team building
selection.text: Assess student applications by skills, motivation and availability. Appoint team captains.

training.name: Training and technical plan
training.text: Track the official rules. Confirm the technical plan, work split and test criteria with each team.

prototype.name: Prototype and testing
prototype.text: Allocate lab time. Discuss test results, open risks and material needs.

application.name: Pitch and application
application.text: Put the technical report, demo video and pitch through an internal review. Complete the application in the official system.

results.name: Results and continuity
results.text: Document results and lessons learned. Set the next stage for continuing projects.
